## `market_cap` · Market cap

```text
Market cap (market_cap) · size_liquidity · usd · basis mixed · price tier
Formula: Unadjusted close × shares outstanding (§4.3 rules 11–12), shares adjusted for splits between the 
count's date and the price date. Share basis: the latest cover-page total (else balance-sheet, else diluted 
weighted count, DERIVED_INPUT); for an Up-C, its economic count (the sum of its cover-page classes). 
Multi-class companies: Σ class shares × a close per class, counts from the latest 10-K/10-Q cover: each 
separately listed class at its own close; an unlisted class the filing confirms has the same dividend and 
liquidation rights (quoted in config/share_classes.yaml `unlisted_economic`) at the close of the listed class 
it converts into. Voting-only classes never count. STALE_DATA if the share count is more than a year older 
than the latest balance sheet.
Apple Inc. (AAPL, CIK 0000320193) · TTM end 2026-09-26 · balance sheet 2026-09-26 (year ago 2025-09-27)
```

## `enterprise_value` · Enterprise value

```text
Enterprise value (enterprise_value) · size_liquidity · usd · basis mixed · price tier
Formula: market_cap + total_debt + preferred + minority_interest − cash − st_investments (MRQ balances). 
Preferred, minority interest and short-term investments not tagged on the balance sheet count as none (noted);
total_debt must be tagged. total_debt includes finance leases where the filing presents them outside debt 
(when no filing says where, they're left out and the ⓘ says so: INPUT_EXCLUDES); operating leases are 
excluded.
```
